author: Grace Hall
title: Mamdani's $30 Wage, Child Care Plan Shakes Up NYC Race - NewsBreak
text:
By Grace Hall ,
19 minutes ago New York City Democratic mayoral candidate Zohran Mamdani has proposed an affordability agenda to reduce living costs and support working families. The plan includes no-cost child care for children aged six weeks to five years, a four-year freeze on rent-stabilized rents, and fare-free buses. It also calls for city-owned grocery stores and a $30 minimum wage.
Mamdani claims he will fund the agenda through a 2% surcharge on incomes over $1 million, raising the corporate tax rate to 11.5%, tougher audits, and contract reforms. Most measures will require state approval.
Mamdani’s campaign noted the plan would reduce family outmigration and increase workforce participation. Gov. Kathy Hochul has endorsed universal child care but expressed concern about funding.
Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis said, “Assuming he gets elected, Mamdani will be the most prominent Democrat in America the day he takes office.” He added, “Voters across the country will be able to watch his leftist agenda in action and know that his path is the Democrat path nationally.”
Mamdani’s four-year rent-freeze proposal would affect nearly two million residents in rent-stabilized units but faces legal and administrative challenges.
Critics have questioned the agenda’s feasibility and fiscal realism. GOP Strategist Adolfo Franco said, “Governor DeSantis is correct.”
Franco added, “The Republican Party will accurately portray Mamdani as the new face of the Democratic Party and emblematic of the extreme, leftist and socialist direction of the Democrats. By comparison, Bernie Sanders and AOC appear moderate to most Americans. His election will alarm the majority of centrists in the country and alienate those voters.”
Grace Hall covers U.S. politics & news for content partner Modern Newsstand LLC.
